build.shape: buff and broad-chested rather than fluffy

sims4_create_a_pet.starting_strategy: Crossbreed Maine Coon with American Shorthair, then replace the coat with a solid short black coat and manually reduce fluff.
sims4_create_a_pet.alternative_start: Use Black Cat or Bombay for the coat, then sculpt toward a broad Maine Coon head and 27-pound visual mass.

traits.name: Affectionate
traits.reason: seeks attention, snuggles, and bonds closely

traits.name: Lazy
traits.reason: sleeps often and seldom initiates play

voice_recipe.note: Use a low-mid pitch: resonant enough for a large cat, but not monster-like.

limitations: Create A Pet does not expose real-world pounds; 27 lb is represented visually.
No official shareable text code encodes every pet sculpt slider and paint stroke.
Trait codenames are reproducible, but exact morphs must be recreated manually or shared through Gallery/Tray data.

behavior.rule: Personality preferences select animation variety; they are not needs, meters, decay values, or obligations.
behavior.resting_style: often chooses sleep, loaf, sit, or groom animations
behavior.play_style: rarely self-initiates; readily participates when the user or scene invites play
behavior.social_style: snuggly, attention-seeking in dialogue, affectionate, expressive, and vocal
